## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes introduced by this Pull Request.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update / Performance optimization

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (`black`, `ruff`, `mypy`).
- [ ] I have added tests in `tests/` that prove my fix is effective or feature works.
- [ ] All existing pytest suites pass locally (`pytest tests/`).
- [ ] I have verified that no API contracts or file names were modified or broken.
- [ ] Benchmarks have been executed if performance was affected (`python benchmarks/run_benchmarks.py --quick`).
